# Draft:Freedom Seekers: Stories of Black Liberation in the American Revolutionary Era and Beyond

Freedom Seekers: Stories of Black Liberation in the American Revolutionary Era and Beyond is a public digital humanities project that researches and publishes narratives of enslaved people who escaped from bondage in the Americas and the Atlantic world between the mid-seventeenth century and 1815. Professor Gloria Whiting from the Department of History at University of Wisconsin-Madison leads the project, which will culminate in 2026 to align with the 250th anniversary of American independence. It is hosted at freedom-seekers.org.
